title: andropogon nardus subsp. grandis
intro: Andropogon nardus subsp. grandis, commonly known as the Black Grass or Black Needle Grass, is a subspecies of the Andropogon nardus plant, belonging to the Poaceae family of grasses. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, where it is traditionally used to treat various ailments, including fever, cough, and respiratory issues, due to its health benefits such as antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory activities. The therapeutic actions of Andropogon nardus subsp. grandis include expectorant, antiseptic, and anti-inflammatory effects, which contribute to its use in treating respiratory infections and other conditions. The bioactive constituents responsible for its medicinal properties are primarily sesquiterpenoids and flavonoids, although further research is needed to fully understand its composition and potential applications.
